mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_audit_log ( tenant_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, operator_organization_id, action_code, action_name_snapshot, target_type, target_id, target_name_snapshot, target_code_snapshot, reason, result, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, CASE #{operatorType} WHEN 'PLATFORM_IDENTITY' THEN ( SELECT identity.username FROM public.iam_platform_identity identity WHERE identity.id = #{operatorId} ) WHEN 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' THEN ( SELECT account.username FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id = #{operatorId} ) ELSE NULL END, CASE #{operatorType} WHEN 'PLATFORM_IDENTITY' THEN ( SELECT COALESCE(identity.display_name, identity.username) FROM public.iam_platform_identity identity WHERE identity.id = #{operatorId} ) WHEN 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' THEN ( SELECT COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id = #{operatorId} ) ELSE NULL END, #{operatorOrganizationId}, #{actionCode}, COALESCE( (SELECT permission.name FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE permission.permission_code = #{actionCode} AND permission.is_deleted = false), #{actionNameSnapshot} ), #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CASE #{targetType} WHEN 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'TENANT' THEN (SELECT tenant.name FROM public.iam_tenant tenant WHERE tenant.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ORGANIZATION' THEN (SELECT organization.name FROM public.iam_organization organization WHERE organization.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ORG_TYPE' THEN (SELECT org_type.name FROM public.iam_org_type org_type WHERE org_type.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN (SELECT role.name FROM public.iam_role role WHERE role.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'PERMISSION_RESOURCE' THEN (SELECT permission.name FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE permission.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) ELSE NULL END, CASE #{targetType} WHEN 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' THEN (SELECT account.username FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'TENANT' THEN (SELECT tenant.tenant_code FROM public.iam_tenant tenant WHERE tenant.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ORGANIZATION' THEN (SELECT organization.business_code FROM public.iam_organization organization WHERE organization.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ORG_TYPE' THEN (SELECT org_type.type_code FROM public.iam_org_type org_type WHERE org_type.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN (SELECT role.role_code FROM public.iam_role role WHERE role.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) WHEN 'PERMISSION_RESOURCE' THEN (SELECT permission.permission_code FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE permission.id = CAST(#{targetId} AS bigint)) ELSE NULL END, #{reason}, #{result}, #{traceId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO public.iam_audit_log ( event_id, schema_version, source_code, category_path_snapshot, app_code_snapshot, tenant_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, operator_organization_id, action_code, action_name_snapshot, target_type, target_id, target_name_snapshot, target_code_snapshot, reason, result, failure_reason_code, trace_id, occurred_time, duration_ms, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{sourceCode}, CAST(#{categoryPathJson} AS jsonb), #{appCodeSnapshot}, #{tenantId}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorUsernameSnapshot}, #{operatorDisplayNameSnapshot}, #{operatorOrganizationId}, #{actionCode}, #{actionNameSnapshot}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetNameSnapshot}, #{targetCodeSnapshot}, #{reason}, #{result}, #{failureReasonCode}, #{traceId}, #{occurredTime}, #{durationMs}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, schema_version, source_code, category_path_snapshot::text AS category_path_json, app_code_snapshot, tenant_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, operator_organization_id, action_code, action_name_snapshot, target_type, target_id, target_name_snapshot, target_code_snapshot, reason, result, failure_reason_code, trace_id, occurred_time, duration_ms, created_time FROM public.iam_audit_log WHERE ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
